classifications.subject: gate:clean vs gate:local/local validation
classifications.rationale: a clean checkout must prove a fresh environment from a disposable clone with npm ci; reusing local state would destroy the property the lane exists to prove

classifications.subject: campaign:synthetic vs npm test (same lifecycle)
classifications.rationale: the required SYNTHETIC_CAMPAIGN gate group must stand alone in its receipt, and the full regression must be independently complete; within a certification lifecycle the repetition is by design, not accidental
classifications.fastDevGuidance: SAFE_TO_SKIP_IN_FAST_DEV_LANE: the fast lane may select the affected subset instead

classifications.subject: semantic-compatibility vs npm test (same lifecycle)
classifications.rationale: the compatibility cone has its own skip policy and receipt; the full regression covers the same files independently
classifications.fastDevGuidance: SAFE_TO_SKIP_IN_FAST_DEV_LANE: the fast lane may select the affected subset instead

classifications.subject: owner-provenance vs npm test (same lifecycle)
classifications.rationale: owner provenance is a required gate group with its own receipt and zero-skip contract
classifications.fastDevGuidance: SAFE_TO_SKIP_IN_FAST_DEV_LANE: the fast lane may select the affected subset instead

classifications.subject: Playwright globalSetup proxy per invocation
classifications.rationale: each invocation owns its lease and runtime state suffix; sharing a proxy across processes would break containment and port-lease ownership

classifications.subject: agent:check and agent:audit inside AGENT_CONTINUITY
classifications.rationale: both scan the same task inventory in the same group; a single pass emitting both judgements would be equivalent, pending a semantics-preserving tool change

classifications.subject: loadTypeScriptModules compilation across lanes
classifications.rationale: deterministic source-to-module compilation keyed by source SHA and loader version is immutable; a cross-process cache is only safe with those identity keys

classifications.subject: full regression re-running gate-lane files in the same certification run
classifications.rationale: deduplicating it would change the meaning of either the gate or the full regression; the campaign removes none of it
